source_text: Qui in lucis aeternitate persistit refert Deo gloriam in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Who remains in the eternity of light brings glory back to God forever and ever. Amen.
pass_b_english: Stay in eternal light and give God glory [[forever and ever >> Bible:Revelation 1:6]]. Amen.
